subject: world_language
concept: Editing and revising one's own writing for grammatical accuracy and stylistic clarity
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student compares a draft passage with errors to a corrected version and identifies the fixes
exercise.abstract: Student revises their own written work for grammatical accuracy and clarity, explaining the changes made

assessment.mastery_threshold: revision shows genuine correction of real errors, not just superficial word changes
misconception_flags: makes cosmetic edits without correcting the actual grammatical or clarity issues present

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
